alice_support: Hi @customer_jdoe — digging into the invoice spike you reported. You said the SDK tokenizer shows ~2.1k tokens but the invoice line shows ~3.4k for the same chat session, correct? Can you paste the request id or a sample payload?

customer_jdoe: Yep — invoice for Mar 10th is +1.3k tokens over our estimate. Request id r-9a3f. We're on node SDK v0.9.1, we count client-side with `@redwood/tokenizer` and only account for `system/user/assistant` text we send/receive. No function calls on our side explicitly.

alice_support: Thanks. I pulled the server logs for r-9a3f. The API request that reached the runtime actually contains additional injected messages the SDK doesn't surface — a runtime policy preamble and a sidecar-inserted tool prompt. Those tokens are billable and live in the server meter. Excerpt from the server-observed messages array (sanitized):

```
"messages": [
  {"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},
  {"role":"system","content":"<internal:runtime-injector:org-policy-v1>\nallowed_actions: [...long policy blob...]"},
  {"role":"user","content":"Summarize today's logs."},
  {"role":"tool","name":"file-search","content":"Search results: fileA.txt (430 tokens)\nfileB.txt (80 tokens)"},
  {"role":"assistant","content":"Found files — do you want a summary?"}
]
```

alice_support: That injected policy + tool results added ~1.3k tokens to the server-side request/response bundle. The SDK estimator only tokenizes the user/system messages the client constructs and intentionally omits internal injector/system tool messages right now, which is why the two counts diverge.

bob_engineer: Confirming — runtime-injector appends organization policy text and sometimes resolves a preflight tool (search/route) to help routing/failover. Those objects can be long (policy templates, redaction logs). Metering counts canonicalized bytes of every message role (system/tool included). The SDK's estimator was designed to avoid exposing internal artifacts, so it undercounts in these cases.

sam_runtime: Repro steps we used: replay the recorded request with `x-request-id: r-9a3f` against the production metering endpoint and compare headers. Example curl: 

```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "x-request-id: r-9a3f" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/replay?r=r-9a3f \
  -D - -o /dev/null
# Response headers include:
# X-Metering-Request-Tokens: 3456
# X-Metering-Response-Tokens: 980
```

sam_runtime: The important bit is that the server-side canonicalization counts the injected `system` and `tool` entries. If you want a client-equivalent number, you need to add lengths for `runtime-injector` + any `tool` results inserted.

alice_support: Short-term remediation options: 1) We can request a one-time invoice credit while engineering updates docs and SDK helpers; 2) Customers on Dedicated/Private can disable injector or run with `no_inject` flag; 3) We'll add an estimator helper that optionally includes known injector payloads so client counts match server.

tina_billing: Billing note — invoices are generated from server metering logs; they are correct per our billing rules. We can escalate for a goodwill credit while the estimator is improved. @alice_support please collect affected invoices and customer approval form.

alice_support: I've created support ticket S-7241 to collect affected invoice ids. For quick help, here's a tiny node snippet customers can run locally to approximate server tokens by adding an injector length heuristic:

```
// naive server-aligned token delta helper
const {countTokens} = require('@redwood/tokenizer');
function serverEstimate(messages, injectorFallback = true) {
  let t = 0;
  for (const m of messages) t += countTokens(m.content);
  if (injectorFallback) {
    // conservative added tokens we observed for org-policy + tool payloads
    t += 1200; // empirical in this org's case
  }
  return t;
}
```

customer_jdoe: We'll try the `no_inject` flag (if available) on our next test run and file S-7241 details. Please also send the credit request form. :pray:

bob_engineer: Internal: created INF-4123 to update SDK estimator to include `runtime-injector` entries when the `include_internal` flag is set. Will also add doc note under "Metering differences".

metering-bot: Analysis complete for r-9a3f — server_tokens=3456, client_estimate=2120, injected_system_and_tool=1336. Logged to INF-4123.
